SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Crop Establishment • Preparing planting site • Planting, part of FOOD PRODUCTION PROCESSES Strand Sub strand Specific learning outcomes Suggested in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade seven GRADE.

Key inquiry question: How does planting material determine planting site preparation?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

B. At home with your parent or guardian
